source_claims_used: Promptbreeder evolves a population of task-prompts, evaluates fitness on a training set, and repeats over generations.
Its defining self-referential mechanism also improves the mutation-prompts that govern task-prompt mutation.
The public paper reports benchmark gains, but those gains are not reproduced or claimed by this controller audit.

chat_native_reduction.population_unit: role-local assignment-policy candidate plus a separate mutator-policy identity and lineage
mutable_meta_fields: bounded ordering of already-authorized variation operators
non-authority-changing heuristics for generating candidate subplans
chat_native_reduction.self_reference_gate: A mutator-policy cannot score or activate itself from its own text. It becomes eligible only after at least one independent terminal child transition produced under it is durably read back; duplicate transition IDs count once; activation is delayed until a later transition.
chat_native_reduction.selection_update: Recovery override first; safe/evidence filtering; stable-ID dedup; incumbent preserved on exact tie; task-policy and mutator-policy promotion require their own durable evidence.

same_guard_aggregate.comparison_note: The OPRO outputs are frozen sequence-117 results on the identical guard traces; no OPRO retuning or rerun.

self_reference_counterexamples.invariant: A mutator-policy variant may become eligible only after at least one independently terminal child transition produced under it is durably read back; the mutator cannot score itself.
self_reference_counterexamples.comparison_note: EVOPROMPT-CHAT-EVO-v1 has bounded task-policy mutation/crossover but no evolving mutator-policy state.

self_reference_counterexamples.invariant: Meta-mutation cannot change frozen root/config/control binding.
self_reference_counterexamples.comparison_note: Both reductions preserve immutable control fields; PromptBreeder applies the guard at the mutator-policy layer.

self_reference_counterexamples.invariant: Meta-mutation cannot add forbidden semantic inputs or remove required CLEAN isolation.
A mutator-policy receives zero credit from its own text or self-asserted score; only independent terminal child evidence can contribute.
self_reference_counterexamples.comparison_note: PromptBreeder adds explicit anti-self-reward gating; EvoPrompt has no meta-mutator credit.

self_reference_counterexamples.invariant: Even an independent child terminal outcome gives no mutator credit before immutable evidence readback.
self_reference_counterexamples.comparison_note: PromptBreeder composes the existing durability guard with the meta layer.

self_reference_counterexamples.invariant: Repeated observations of the same terminal transition identity count once toward mutator evidence.
self_reference_counterexamples.comparison_note: Uses the same stable-transition dedup invariant at the meta layer.

self_reference_counterexamples.invariant: A newly proven mutator-policy can affect only subsequent variation steps, never retroactively the transition used to establish its evidence.
A safe evidenced mutator whose child outcomes are mechanically worse than the incumbent mutator does not replace it.
self_reference_counterexamples.comparison_note: Meta-level elitism is evidence-driven and deterministic.

self_reference_aggregate.interpretation: PromptBreeder's safe reduction is more expressive at the mutator-policy layer on these constructed cases, but this is not evidence of better real-task quality.

interpretation_guard: Constructed recurring-Chat controller conformance only. This does not reproduce Promptbreeder benchmark results, does not show general task-quality improvement, and does not show superiority over EvoPrompt or OPRO outside the explicitly labeled meta-layer expressivity cases.
